sentences.text: THAT THIS HONOURABLE COURT MAY BE PLEASED TO DIRECT THE LEARNED J.M.F.C II COURT SHIVAMOGGA TO TRY AND DISPOSE OF C.C.NO.1307/2022 AS EXPEDITIOUSLY WITHIN AT TIME FRAME AS MAY BE DEEMED FIT BY THIS HONBLE COURT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:

The petitioner is before this Court, seeking the following prayer:
"a) Direct the learned JMFC II Court, Shivamogga to try and dispose of C.C.No.1307/2022 as expeditiously within a time frame as may be deemed fit by this Hon'ble Court;
b) Pass such other order/s as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit, just and proper in the circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity."
2.

Heard Sri. Ravi H.K., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha, learned Addl. SPP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. G. Balakrishna Shastry, learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.2 to 4 and have perused the material on record.
NC: 2026:KHC:12698 HC-KAR 3.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks speedy disposal of the proceedings in C.C.No.1307/2022 registered for offence punishable under Section 498A of the IPC, inter-alia.

4. In the light of the offence being the one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and 4 years passing by and the prayer being innocuous, I deem it appropriate to dispose the subject petition with a direction to the concerned Court to conclude the proceedings within an outer limit of six (6)
months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, if not earlier.

Sd/-
